newsitem.title: CHINA: China PICC units pay 1.459 bln yuan reinsurance.
newsitem.headline: China PICC units pay 1.459 bln yuan reinsurance.

text.p: Two subsidiaries of the People's Insurance Company (Group) of China (PICC) have paid a total of 1.459 billion yuan ($175.7 million) to the country's sole reinsurer, the Financial News said on Thursday.
Under China's Insurance Law, domestic insurers must distribute 20 percent of their business to PICC Reinsurance, also a PICC unit, to diversify their risks, the newspaper said.
Of the total, PICC Property Co paid 1.288 billion yuan and the PICC Life Co paid 171 million yuan, it said.
Despite the PICC payment, many domestic insurance companies were unwilling to pay their contributions and distort their premium income, it said.
